Last Friday, Max and Kate went to the playground. Kate is interested in reading. It takes twenty minutes to get to the playground by bike. In fact, the office is issuing new student cards this week.
They took many photos at the science lab. Max hopes to visit Rome one day. The playground is one of the best places in the city. Best of all, she works as a nurse in the pediatric ward.
Max wrote about the day in the diary. Max spent the weekend at the zoo. Life is full of small surprises. What's more, a term of study abroad changed her major.
There are always many people at the science lab. Max is reading a book about art. Max drinks coffee after doing sports.
